verdict.rationale: Phoenix's docs index describes "Phoenix Intelligence, the built-in AI agent" to which users can hand investigations, and it inspects traces, iterates prompts and runs experiments. That matches delegating tasks to an in-product assistant, but the only evidence is a single llms.txt index line. The remote MCP endpoint and coding-agent CLI setup are external-client integrations, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party docs page on Phoenix Intelligence, details on which tasks it can carry out on its own and how users invoke it in the UI, and independent or hands-on confirmation that it works.
